name: Nothing Happened 3: Terminus Wave
source:
A slice-of-life kinetic visual novel and the sequel to 2015's GGJ entry, Nothing Happened and 2016's GGJ entry, Nothing Happened 2: The Ritual. Story: The genius and his female AR companion are dispatched to investigate a strange phenomenon in Makati City. In this grand finale, everything about the two will be revealed.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/nothing-happened-3-terminus-wave]Global Game Jam[/url]]

Created for Global Game Jam 2017.
translation:
一部日常题材的动视小说，是2015年GGJ作品《Nothing Happened》和2016年GGJ作品《Nothing Happened 2：仪式》的续作。故事讲述天才与他的女性AR伙伴奉命调查马卡蒂市的奇异现象。在这部大结局中，两人的一切都会揭晓。

（来源：[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/nothing-happened-3-terminus-wave]Global Game Jam[/url]）
